text:
Sarah L: Quick sync — planning the SI Accelerator onboarding next quarter. Need to align marketplace listing + hardware kit training. Can we do a 15-min plan?
Miguel G: Love it. We should define certification levels (bronze/silver/gold) and clear acceptance criteria for each.
Priya S: Agree. My suggestion: hands-on lab + proctored checklist for silver, plus a partner-facing end-to-end demo for gold.
Tom H: For the cloud marketplace, the listing needs an ISV package + a test deployment in aws/us-west-2. Who will own the staging deploy?
Jen K: I can own the marketplace packaging on our side. Will need access to a staging cluster and the model artifacts.
Sarah L: Assigning Jen for packaging. Miguel — can you draft the certification criteria by Friday?
Miguel G: On it. I'll post a short matrix in the doc covering infra, security, performance, and demos.
Priya S: We also need a 2-hour train-the-trainer session, slide deck, and lab steps. Carlos — can you run the labs for the pilot?
Carlos M: Yes, I can run them. I'll need the hardware kit inventory and a sample config from the hw partner ops team.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: Q2 SI Accelerator kickoff doc created — https://notion.redwood.com/si-accelerator-kickoff
Tom H: Hardware ask — confirm partner can preflash images and provide 3 demo units for the pilot. @Miguel G please confirm budget for units.
Miguel G: :thumbsup: I'll check budget and get back by Wednesday.
Jen K: Also we need a legal checklist for co-marketing and to lock the joint announcement window. Legal typically needs ~2 weeks.
Sarah L: Good point. I'll loop in legal. Tentative timeline: pilot with 3 SIs in June, formal certification program live in July.
Priya S: Can we create a short rubric for the certification exam? A few sample tasks and a pass threshold would help partners prep.
Miguel G: Yes — sample tasks I'll include: deploy package to marketplace, run perf test (95th pct < 120ms), and demo an end-to-end inference flow.
Carlos M: For the labs repo I'll provide terraform scripts, docker images, and a troubleshooting doc. Will draft the repo this week.
Sarah L: Next steps recap: Jen = packaging + staging access; Miguel = cert criteria + sample tasks; Carlos = labs repo + hardware coord. Quick sync Thursday 10am to check progress. :calendar:
Priya S: Works for me.
Tom H: Works.
Jen K: Added to calendar, thanks!
